text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It has been sealed away... The means to 
enlighten others on the charm of my 
family...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—where on earth am I supposed to direct 
all these overflowing emotions...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to vent her family love due to 
Umatter maintenance, Dream Journey's mood 
soured considerably.
